grouping.body: mask placeholders, URLs, email addresses and digits; at least 10 words
grouping.closure: transitive components including declared parent links
grouping.exact: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse; subject plus body
grouping.near_body: word-trigram set Jaccard >= 0.90, exact prefix-index search
grouping.subject: same normalized subject, at least 15 characters and 3 words

source.citation: Luca Pajola, Eugenio Caripoti, Simeone Pizzi, Mauro Conti, Stefan Banzer, Giovanni Apruzzese. E-PhishGen: Unlocking Novel Research in Phishing Email Detection. AISec 2025. https://doi.org/10.1145/3733799.3762967
